description: This file provides a WebSocket client helper for order tracking in a food delivery frontend application. It defines a WebSocket URL, and a function to create and manage a WebSocket connection with optional token authentication, along with lifecycle and message event handlers.

methods.name: createTrackingSocket({ token = null, onMessage = () => {}, onOpen = () => {}, onClose = () => {}, onError = () => {} } = {})
methods.description: Creates and manages a WebSocket connection for order tracking, allowing optional token-based authentication and callback handlers for message, open, close, and error events.
